verdict.rationale: Pomelo publishes a public API reference covering users, cards, accounts, transactions, adjustments and credit. It has URL-versioned endpoints, cURL/JavaScript samples and separate Stage and production hosts, so the product can be driven programmatically. However, API access is provisioned through Pomelo's integration process rather than self-serve, and the reference is static, with no machine-readable spec (all OpenAPI/Swagger paths return 404) and no versioning policy, deprecation window or changelog. missing for 10: downloadable OpenAPI spec, self-serve API access/credentials, published versioning and deprecation policy or changelog, interactive try-it reference, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
